rationale: The matured approach for the product-1 quest is exceptionally rigorous, well-aligned with the repository's fail-closed trust model, and ready for Argo implementation. The E1-E6 enforcement mechanisms correctly establish credential separation, deterministic validation, verifiable authority anchoring, and an exceptionless default-deny posture. The atomic weave rule correctly accounts for the paradox of self-referential git hashes by verifying the woven closure sans evidence, and CI mode-splitting cleanly guarantees that historical mode cannot be abused to bypass weave updates. The SPIKE-E6-EVALUATOR-FORM deferral is acceptable: postponing the concrete grammar of the declarative oracle language to its own gate is sound because the fail-closed interim (mandatory adversarial source review coupled with the pure-ABI evaluator and determinized execution battery) safely prevents any lookup-table or escape-hatch bypasses in the meantime. The S2/S3 open questions and S0 carve-outs are ratified in alignment with the recorded Eye rulings. No structural contradictions, unhandled capabilities, or plan-level defects remain.
